title: Good quick trip to Cordoba
text: No place like  Cordoba in the world. Our guides, Daniella and Ricardo, were lovely. If you want a quick overview of one of the most culturally fascinating places in Europe, this trip fits the bill.
author: janekI5080KK

title: Amazing day trip to Cordoba
text:
Andrea was awesome.  We had a great time with Andulsur excursions. Our guide was super informative, walked us through the different areas. We visited two courtyards, the synagogue, had lots of time to browse the shops before lunch. After lunch we met with the local tour guide for a visit of the Mesquita with skip the line tickets. Amazing. Ricardo the guide for the Mesquita was so passionate and giving us a lot of information to help us understand what we were seeing.

We used two different tour companies while in Seville - Naturanda and Andulsur. ANDULSUR was the best in everything - punctual
author: Nalina_R

title: Not to be missed
text: Absolutely beautiful! The mosque/cathedral is amazing and can’t be missed. We enjoyed walking around the old city and seeing all the patio gardens. Our guide Driss was very friendly and informative. Wonderful day
author: Carol_D

title: Best Day in Cordoba
text: Great one day trip to Cordoba.   Dreis Castro is the best guide in all of Andalucia.   He allows for a relaxed pace and personally checks in with each guest.

title: Great experience day tour.
text: Excellent tour, our guide Alex was very knowledgeable and entertaining. He was very passionate and enthusiastic, gave us lots of history and made sure everyone was well looked after.
